issues.problem:
Thinness and the verdict disagree on what a gap is, inside the window (CONTACT_TOL 0.010, HIDE_OFFSET 0.012]. Factors.luau:80 merges union chords only across gaps ≤ CONTACT_TOL (the test at :189; §5.2 line 1270 says the same). The verdict hides the faces on either side of any gap up to HIDE_OFFSET + EPS_GEOM (§4.4). So a laminate inside that window reads as one solid to the 2 % rule and to SurfaceComplexity, and as two thin plates to Thinness.

Reproduction: F5 with its blade (0.16 × 2.60 × 0.06 at y 2.68) split into two plates through its thickness, outer thickness kept. Plate thickness is (0.06 − g)/2 and the plates sit at z ±(g/2 + t/2). Script: scratch work/gapwin.luau.
- The facing faces are hidden at g 0.0099 and at g 0.0101 alike: each plate exposes 0.546 of 0.970 (work/gapexp.luau). They show only from g 0.0121, where each plate exposes 0.951.
- F5: Hammering 0.1035 Normal at g 0.0099 → 0.3981 Hard at g 0.0101. Thinness goes 0.2588 → 0.9952 while SurfaceComplexity raw stays put (2.2224 → 2.2254). The result is the same at every gap up to 0.0120.
- The same 0.0099 → 0.0101 change flips 5 of 5 fixtures (work/gapwin2.luau): C02 0.1137 → 0.3921, C08 0.1212 → 0.4430 (raw Expert), C05 0.1435 → 0.2135, F2 0.0176 → 0.3134.
- A gap change of 0.0002 that never shows therefore moves Hammering by 0.07–0.32 and a tier.

Nothing in §5.6, §17.1 O10/O11 or §17.2 states this. X05's gaps (0.002–0.009) and X07's flush or overlapping laminates all lie at or under CONTACT_TOL. Edge's chord thickness (Edge.luau:283, 287) has the same window: F5's laminate cutIndex goes 0.7242 → 0.9063 (S4's input, not D).
issues.fix:
Merge Thinness' chords across what the verdict hides across. In Factors.luau:80 replace
  local CONTACT_TOL = Limits.CONTACT_TOL
with
  local CONTACT_TOL = Geo.HIDE_OFFSET + Geo.EPS_GEOM -- what the verdict hides across (§4.4)
and make §5.2 read "gaps ≤ HIDE_OFFSET merged".

issues.problem:
Each probe's θ depends on how a part is written, not on the solid it describes. thinAxis (:207–222) picks:
- for a polyhedron, the smallest half extent, with ties broken X < Y < Z;
- for a long Cylinder, its local Y, a radial direction set by how the Cylinder is spun about its own axis;
- for a Ball, its local X.

M2's verdict is writing-invariant by design: §4.4 ranks a Block by its sorted half extents and fixes round models in world frames. Thinness (:271, :288) is not.

Reproduction (work/writing2.luau): F5 with part 4 (the blade) set to 0.05 thick, plus a Blade Block 0.03 × 2.4 × 0.03 at (0, 2.68, 0.04) on the blade's face.
- The rib written with rotation I: Hammering 0.2117 Hard.
- The same solid written with rotation {0, R, 0, R}, a quarter turn about its own length: 0.1637 Normal.
- A Blade Cylinder 2.4 × 0.03 × 0.03 in the same place, written Z90: 0.2034 Hard. Written Z90 ⊗ (90° about its axis): 0.1641 Normal.
- On F5 as it is (blade 0.06 thick), the rib's two writings differ by 0.0728 in Hammering.

Smelting, Sharpening, the cleaned list and every factor other than Thinness are identical between the two writings, so the difference is M3's alone. §5's lead promises that invisible construction choices cannot move a tier. §5.2, §5.6 and O11 state flush re-cuts and Y-shift ties, not a part turned or spun about its own symmetry.
issues.fix:
Make θ a property of the solid. Tried in my copy; the diff is at scratch work/out/factors_fix.diff.

Add thinAxes(p):
- a Ball: world X;
- a disc (hx ≤ r): its axis;
- a rod: r1 = normalize(axis × thicknessAxis) and r2 = axis × r1, falling back to world X and Y when the axis lies along Z;
- a polyhedron: every local axis whose half extent equals the smallest (==).

Then in thinness compute
  local tau = unionChord(W, x, y, z, zx, zy, zz)
  for a = 1, #axes, 3 do tau = min(tau, unionChord(W, x, y, z, axes[a], axes[a + 1], axes[a + 2])) end
and charge one more chord per extra axis.

Results:
- The rib gives 0.2117 / 0.2117 and the rod 0.2034 / 0.2034.
- Of all fixtures, only C13 moves: Hammering 0.1133 → 0.1134 (Thinness 0.28314 → 0.28356), no tier. That needs C13 re-blessed in T-DIF-12's calibration golden and its [8.2] and Difficulty.spec rows updated.
- The slow T-DIF-04, T-DIF-07, T-DIF-08 and T-DIF-10 cases pass.
- V1Major.spec case 2 fails on the build ("expected 0.2117, got 0.1637") and passes with the change.

summary:
